name: The sandbox, schematic
title: The sandbox, schematic
story: The factory sends a card into one throwaway pod: gVisor, non-root, read-only root, no service account token. A probe tries the internet, the host machine and the cloud metadata address, all crossed out, and only named hosts are open; then the agent runs. One model call goes through the gateway, which holds the keys, reserves the worst case against the card's budget and books the real cost. The pod holds a one-hour gateway identity, no push token and no model key. Calls fill the budget to its cap, the factory stops and a person decides: fund it or end it. At the end the factory ticks off its list: kill the agent's processes, mint a write token, push once, revoke it, delete the pod.
